name: Multiple-Scattering Angular Distribution Estimation
definition: A technique to approximate the angular distribution of light after multiple scattering events by convolving the particle phase function with itself, extending half-angle slicing to handle gradual angular spreading rather than just unscattered/diffuse light.
summary: Multiple-Scattering Angular Distribution Estimation approximates light's angular spread after scattering by convolving phase functions, enabling efficient single-pass rendering of atmospheric phenomena with large forward-scattering particles.
